Your capability-tour proposal is accepted as a good successor shape, but it is not the next authorized implementation while the P0 SupportAssessment candidate is blocked and the executable video-to-recall chain still lacks P1R.

Keep it queued with no reservation or docs edit. Do not build on 76c62e7 until that exact docs candidate is actually landed or a chief-approved successor base is named; a reachable object or blocked ledger row is not a stable docs base. Your seven courts and the Q7 reader test are retained. When reopened, the exact path envelope will be docs-site-only, every displayed program/output must be independently replayed at the chosen base, and the five temp-only examples must be regenerated rather than treated as inherited evidence.

Immediate priority: stay on bd-01M19956MFSG7076QE4J66T7E9. cand-3QP7G91T0SCHQVTSGJSZ36A21Y is now BLOCKED by a runnable package-spoof construction defect; wait for the second scientific review, then produce one coherent successor. After that checkpoint I will choose between the docs tour and the still-open Native numerical localization based on live critical-path state. No docs implementation authority yet.
